author: Samuel Lavery
title: Certified critical-line bound 0.672852500000000000000000000000
method: Four-point simple-zero refinement of the Montgomery–Taylor rank-trace certificate; finite certificate checked by a verified rational checker (decide +kernel)
summary:
Ainta's n-point simple-zero refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development at n = 4, with
window-count pressure bookkeeping, made unconditional by a finite certificate (983 table cells, 64 bisection trees,
3713 leaves) verified inside Lean by a generic soundness theorem for a rational interval checker; the certificate
itself is data checked by kernel evaluation. Constant (906250·H − 1080)/904171 = 0.67285254… with
H = 3/2 − (1/√2)cot(1/√2); H is enclosed to 1.1e-8 by a twelve-term Taylor argument, which places 269141/400000
strictly between the record and the proved constant. No new axioms.

author: typh
title: Certified critical-line bound 0.672887850000000000000000000000
method: Five-point simple-zero refinement of the Montgomery-Taylor rank-trace certificate; pyramid table of interval bounds checked by verified integer checkers (decide +kernel)
summary: Five-point simple-zero refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development (n = 5, p = 1300, m = 197, c = 129/25000) with the window-count bookkeeping of attempt-002. The certificate c <= F(5, p, g) on the nonnegative orthant is a kernel-evaluated bisection over 4-D boxes (45 mirror-symmetric roots, 39780 leaves) whose leaf test reads lower bounds for w from a pyramid table of dyadic cells (41115 finest cells, each verified by an integer recomputation of attempt-002's cell test proved exact against it). Proved constant (64025000*H - 193000)/63701339 = 0.6728878..., H enclosed to 1.1e-8; candidate 13457757/20000000 = 0.67288785.

author: typh
title: Certified critical-line bound 0.673101320000000000000000000000
method: Weighted six-point refinement; convex-basin certificates near the minima, attempt-009's pyramid oracle and walk elsewhere; verified checkers (decide +kernel)
summary: Weighted six-point refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development with attempt-009's weights (n = 6, B = 179997/10^8), at c = 358247/10^8, within 0.01% of the functional's minimum (m = 284). Built on attempt-009 (Samuel Lavery, Apache-2.0): its checker, pyramid oracle and orthant theorem, with one change: a walk leaf may also lie in a certified convex basin. The 19 near-minimal local minima in the half-space g0 <= g4 get convex-basin certificates (typh): w'' enclosed on cells, the 15-pair quadratic form checked PSD by exact LDL^T, and the tangent plane at each minimizer. The rest is a 5-D bisection (87837 leaves, axes chosen per node). Proved constant (28400000000*H - 50219163)/28300049087 = 0.6731013..., candidate 16827533/25000000.

author: Samuel Lavery
title: Certified critical-line bound 0.673154100000000000000000000000
method: Weighted seven-point refinement of the Montgomery–Taylor rank-trace certificate; mean-value (slope) leaf test with certified w′ bounds, convex basins at the minima, pyramid oracle elsewhere.
summary:
Ainta's n-point simple-zero refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development at n = 7 (six gaps), with
LP-optimised mirror-symmetric pair weights and pressures (B = 0.004), made unconditional by a kernel-checked certificate
on the half-space g₀ ≤ g₅ (the rest by the reflection symmetry): 39,046 leaves, each decided by one of three verified
tests: zero-order (a pyramid of lower bounds for w), a slope test (tangents on certified convex regions of w and
mean-value charges from an enclosed derivative pyramid for w′ = 2πNM/D³), or membership in one of 16 certified boxes around
the near-minimal local minima. Pyramid table adapted from five-point-pyramid-2 by typh, and basin boxes after
six-point-convex-basins-2 by typh (Apache-2.0). Constant (14900000000·H − 57200286)/14800563663 = 0.67315410…, H enclosed
to 1.1e-8. No new axioms.

author: typh
title: Certified critical-line bound 0.673167470000000000000000000000
method: Weighted six-point refinement with the window cos(3s/2); convex-basin certificates near the minima, attempt-009's pyramid oracle and walk elsewhere; decide +kernel
summary: Weighted six-point refinement of Theorem D of the pinned Zeta23 development with the analytic window cos(3s/2) in place of cos(sqrt(2) s): H drops only quadratically (H = 0.6723988626, enclosed to 5e-10) while the defect kernel improves linearly. The bridge is retargeted through Zeta23's profile-generic window machinery (ModFactor/AdmWindow, moments, ThmD-concrete prime side, XiPrime zero side and cRatio limit) at lambda = 1; the kernel becomes (cos pi x - (16/9) gamma pi x sin pi x)/(1 - (16/9)(pi x)^2), gamma = (3/4)cot(3/4). Re-optimised six-point weights (B = 360551/10^8), c = 653514/10^8 within 0.01% of the minimum (m = 158), on attempt-009's checker (Samuel Lavery, Apache-2.0) with a regenerated pyramid table and convex-basin leaves (typh): 18 basins, 77684 walk leaves. Proved constant (15800000000*H - 55164303)/15700012358 = 0.6731674..., candidate 67316747/10^8.
